subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should the first account/publisher feed API preserve existing legacy personal-publisher ownerUserId content by default, or intentionally publish ownerPublisherId-only feeds?
rationale: This is a new public API contract, and current main has explicit legacy personal-publisher compatibility paths; automation should not choose whether the public contract narrows that behavior.

options.title: Preserve legacy personal content
options.body: Reuse the existing personal-publisher fallback, include legacy ownerUserId rows, add regression tests, and require live route proof before merge.

options.title: Ship ownerPublisherId-only feeds
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept a narrower first slice, but the PR should document that legacy personal content can be absent until backfilled.

options.title: Pause for discovery contract review
options.body: Hold this API until the account feed, publisher state, profile labels, and registry bridge slices settle together.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy personal content
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing personal-publisher fallback, include legacy ownerUserId rows, add regression tests, and require live route proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant publisher fallback, schema, and adjacent feed route history most strongly point to this owner for the contract choice.
